senses.gloss: pr. n.Koḥălith, a district conquered by John Hyrcan, [perh. = לפַח, Num. XXI, 30, cmp. preced. wds. a. פֶּחָם].
units: Kidd. 66ᵃ כ׳ שבמדבר K. in the desert.—אזוב כ׳ a species of hyssop named after that district.
